items.question: Which WNBA teams did Allison Hightower play for?
items.answer: The Connecticut Sun drafted Allison Hightower 15th overall in 2010 out of LSU. She played for Connecticut from 2010 to 2014, made the All-Star team in 2013, and finished with the Washington Mystics in 2017. She averaged 6.1 points in 125 regular-season games.
